$comment: Example shot list produced in phase 3. Values are illustrative. Costs are filled in phase 4 from get_cost preflights, never typed by hand. Portrait ids are filled in phase 5 and first-frame ids in phase 6, once the user has approved them. Every take is animated from its first frame (start_image); the portrait also goes in the video model's identity role where it has one. The reference video is never an input.

cast.description: Woman in her late twenties, slim, shoulder-length curly dark hair, medium-light skin tone, mustard knit sweater, small gold hoop earrings, warm expression that turns from skeptical to delighted; the on-camera speaker.

shots.intended_line: Okay, I did not expect this to be good.

first_frame.description: Handheld selfie framing, bright kitchen at daylight, the host (mustard knit sweater, curly dark hair, gold hoop earrings) holding a slim can toward the camera, skeptical eyebrow raised, soft window light.

shots.visual: From the first frame: she tilts the can, glances at it, then back to the camera with a surprised half-smile while speaking.

shots.intended_line: Zero sugar. Actually tastes like grapefruit.

first_frame.description: Same kitchen, tighter framing on the host (mustard knit sweater, curly dark hair, gold hoop earrings), can raised to her lips, eyes to camera.

shots.visual: From the first frame: she takes a sip, nods, small laugh while speaking.

first_frame.description: Product on a wet marble counter, condensation on the can, soft window light, shallow depth of field.

shots.visual: From the first frame: slow push in on the can, a drop of condensation runs down.

edit_plan: Overlay packshot.png bottom-right during shot 3 for the last 2 seconds.
Title card 'Try it this week' over shot 3, last 1.5 seconds, bold caps.
